headline: Alphabet falls 12%, putting it on course for its biggest ever post-earnings drop
detail: Alphabet's significant post-earnings drop signals potential weakness across the big tech sector. This could put pressure on your other tech holdings and overall market sentiment.
rec: Consider trimming your QQQ (-0.01%) or SMH (-11.84%) positions, both currently marked "TRIM," to reduce exposure to broader tech weakness.
